text:
kiran: Heads-up: planning a scoped deprecation of the fp8 compatibility shim for private clusters. goal: remove shim complexity that causes subtle failures under air-gapped configs.

mira: Why private clusters first? any customer impact analysis?

kiran: two reasons: 1) most shim-related bugs crop up on custom kernels we ship to private, 2) easier to coordinate opt-in per-tenant. fewer blast-radius.

jamal: ops question 1) can we gate by host label? 2) do we need special key rotation notes for KMS-backed deployments?

kiran: yes to host label gating. KMS: we'll add a compatibility note; shim may mask quant profile mismatches that are surfaced after key rotations. security, any concerns?

security: main ask is to ensure audit trails for any runtime-quant-profile rewrite. add `quant_profile_override` in audit logs and include who/what toggled it.

lia: QA: need to prepare prompt sets from AcmeCorp and FinData (the two private customers using shim). also add a small adversarial set that stresses numeric extremes.

mira: can we do an opt-in flag so customers can try shim-free path before we flip defaults? prefer explicit opt-in for private.
kiran: proposal: feature flow: default remains ON for now. create `precision_shim.opt_in` per-tenant. we invite customers to opt-in -> collect metrics -> propose turning off by default after 30 days.

jamal: infra checklist: 1) per-tenant Redis key + persisted in config DB 2) telemetry tag `shim_optin=True/False` 3) dashboard: `quality_regression_score`, `latency_p50`, `token_efficiency` per-tenant.

ops-bot: noted: maintenance window placeholder created for customer trials on 2025-08-15 01:00-03:00 UTC. will email tenant contacts when trial scheduled.

lia: sample regression gating rule for QA: fail if median top1_confidence drops > 3% OR if LL ratio of hallucination_events increases > 1.5x over baseline.

kiran: we should also measure distributional shifts: compare per-token logprob distribution, trigger inspection if KL divergence > 0.05. keep thresholds conservative to avoid noise.

mira: good. can we make the opt-in reversible? i.e., customer can switch back to shim if they see problems without a deploy.

jamal: yes. implementation: runtime checks `tenant_config.precision_shim` at request start. changing DB entry is sufficient; no code deploy. add a short TTL so cached decisions update within 30s.

lia: QA playbook snippet I'll run:
```
# run customer prompt sweep against shim ON/OFF
for p in prompts.txt:
  curl -sS -X POST $ENDPOINT -d "{\"prompt\": \"$p\"}" -H \"X-Tenant: AcmeCorp\" -H \"X-Flag-Shim: false\" 
  collect top1_confidence, tokens, latency
```

kiran: infra-bot: create automation to flip `precision_shim` per-tenant and run canary jobs.

infra-bot: automation job created (#AUT-7821). will support per-tenant flip + schedule.

security: reminder: for private/offline clusters include a signed manifest for the shim removal plan. customers may need to review for compliance.

mira: communications: I'll draft customer-facing note suggesting opt-in trial + link to expected metrics. will CC account teams.

kiran: rollback plan: immediate toggle back to shim ON if `quality_regression_score` > 0.02 AND customer support ticket created OR if latency increases > 15% p50. jamal, can you wire those into alerting?

jamal: will add alert rules and an alert dedupe window (2h) to avoid flapping. also include runbook link.

lia: timeline suggestion: week -1 announce; week 0 enable opt-in + run internal canaries; week 2 open customer opt-ins; week 6 evaluate and decide default.

kiran: final ask: add `model_quant_profile` to error logs when runtime mismatch occurs so we can map failures to specific quant profiles.

jamal: done. telemetry change scheduled in next infra deploy.

ops-bot: reminder: add support rotation note for tenants participating in opt-in trial.

mira: thanks. I'll push draft and tag legal/compliance for the signed manifest template. sync Monday 9am PT. :thumbsup:
